🌆 Market News Digest
[Nov 16, 2026, pre-market to close EST]

🔥 Top Stories
• Nvidia under pressure as Washington tightens AI-chip access — U.S. restricted remote access to advanced AI chips; Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” Jensen Huang returning, but Nvidia’s board says no return is being considered.
• Risk-off day for U.S. equities — Nasdaq sank 2.58%, S&P 500 1.97%, with traders citing tech weakness, higher-rate fears and headline risk.
• Oil slumps on supply recovery signals — WTI settled at $85.72 and Brent at $92.44 as markets priced a looser supply outlook despite Middle East tension.
• Banks hit by widespread outage reports — Chase, BofA, Wells Fargo and others saw service disruptions; firms said no evidence yet of cyberattacks or systemic failure.
• Trump Asia trip sets up high-stakes diplomacy — Kremlin signaled Putin-Xi talks and possible Trump-Putin-Xi meeting; Trump said trade, Ukraine, Iran and denuclearization are on the table.

⛽ Oil & Energy
• Ukraine struck Russia’s Ilsky refinery; Iran-linked tension also lifted attention to Hormuz risk even as crude sold off.
• Chevron nears roughly $5B deal for Beacon Offshore, expanding Gulf deepwater output.
• SPR crude stocks fell to 276.4M barrels, lowest since 1982.

📊 Markets & Macro
• Canada CPI held at 3.1% y/y, below estimates; U.S. Empire manufacturing missed badly at 7.8 vs 18 expected.
• Fed’s Hammack warned inflation is broadening and rates may need to stay restrictive longer.
• Goldman cut 2026-27 oil forecasts; Barclays trimmed its 2027 S&P 500 target to 8,700.
• Fitch said North American sovereign outlook is worsening on U.S. fiscal risk; CBOE VIX rose to 21.1.

🌍 Geopolitical
• Russia said new U.S.-Russia-Ukraine peace talks are being arranged in Abu Dhabi; Europe’s role remains disputed.
• Iran-related escalation risk stayed elevated after reports of drone/drone-defense activity and tanker incidents in Hormuz.
• Saudi coalition intercepted Houthi drones; Trump warned on Iran and migrant/caravan pressure at the border.

🪙 Crypto & DeFi
• Solana dropped the “mainnet beta” label and moved to protocol version 1.0.
• Strategy bought 485 BTC and expanded holdings to 850,849 BTC, but Bitcoin ETFs saw another $1.07B in weekly outflows.
• Germany proposed crypto seizures without criminal charges; a U.S. judge cleared MIT-educated brothers in a $25M MEV heist case.
• Zelle picked Solana for international payments using stablecoins; Kalshi bought a brokerage to expand into stock trading.

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• U.S. tightened rules on remote access to advanced AI chips and re-export licensing for several countries.
• California sued OpenAI over alleged AI-model cyberattacks; Anthropic shortened vulnerability disclosure deadlines.
• Supreme Court rejected Trump’s bid to cut off DEI-related grants.
• Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem will step down in June 2027.

🏢 Corporate
• Tyson beat on EPS and sales but guided cautiously on 2027 sales and capex.
• Tesla plans an additional €3B investment in Grünheide, with Cybercab production and more hiring targeted.
• OpenAI explored a $5B+ deal for Goodfire; Altimeter’s Brad Gerstner said Anthropic IPO demand is 10-20x oversubscribed.
